_comment: TECHNEST 2026 capstone awards — FROZEN RESULTS. Award voting closed 2026-08-06.
These vote counts are a deliberate snapshot of GET /api/capstones at
updatedAt 2026-08-05T13:06:06.568Z, not a live read. Certificates are permanent
and linked from students' LinkedIn profiles, so rank must never be able to change
underneath them. Likes on /capstone-showcase remain open but no longer reorder
anything and do not affect any award.
Plain JSON rather than a .js module so both webpack (the site) and plain Node
(scripts/render-certificates.mjs) read exactly the same source of truth.
Do not edit rank, tier, votes or certId after issue.
ranks 1..6 by frozen votes, ties broken by submittedAt ascending — the same rule
/capstone-showcase already used. CreditHero and Data Dungeon both hold 9 votes;
the tie is cosmetic because both sit in the same tier.
citation is hand-written and capped at ~120 chars. It is NOT the Notion pitch —
several pitches run past 300 characters and would overflow a fixed-size certificate.
_issuedOnLabelNote: Localised labels live here beside the default rather than being formatted with Intl at render time: `new Date('2026-08-06')` is UTC midnight and renders as the 5th west of Greenwich, and any server/client disagreement would be a hydration mismatch. Keeping them next to issuedOn also means a change to the date cannot silently leave a translation behind.

excellence.label: Award of Excellence
excellence._accentNote: Stone gray, not sandstone. Sandstone #e0dbce is a recessed fill for white surfaces; on the cream certificate it is invisible, so the laurels and accent edge read as a rendering fault rather than as restraint. Stone gray is 3.2:1 on cream — fine here because the accent is only ever a non-text shape (DESIGN.md).
